subject: design-technology
title: Sketching for Design
welcome_lead: Quick design drawings that show your thinking.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: design sketches, annotation, multiple ideas.
final_note: Good designers sketch, sketch and sketch some more.

concepts.def: Notes next to drawing explaining ideas.
Improved version of an earlier idea.
Adding tone, colour, texture to a drawing.
Drawing simple boxes first to get shape.

walkthroughs.body_html: Designers draw many thumbnail ideas before choosing. Volume builds quality — 20 quick sketches beat 1 careful one for finding fresh thinking.
Annotation = notes around your sketches explaining: what materials, what colours, how it works, why it's good. Examiners can't read your mind.
Rendering means adding tone, colour and texture to make a sketch look real. Use coloured pencils, markers, or digital tools. Show light source consistently.
